title: Separable perturbation and factor selection
statement: Let $K$ be a separably closed field [def-kun-separably-closed], let $K(t)$ carry a valuation subring $O$ with $R=O\cap K$, and suppose $f\in K[T]$ is monic irreducible and $f(t)/\pi\in O^\times$ has transcendental residue over $\kappa(R)$ for some $\pi\in K^\times$. Then there is a monic separable irreducible polynomial $g\in K[T]$ and $\pi'\in K^\times$ such that $g(t)/\pi'\in O^\times$ and its residue is transcendental over $\kappa(R)$. Since $K$ is separably closed, every monic separable irreducible $g\in K[T]$ has degree one. Here $K$ is a field [def-weil-field], $K[T]$ is the polynomial ring in one indeterminate [def-weil-polynomial-ring], and a valuation subring $B$ of a field $F$ is a subring with $x\in B$ or $x^{-1}\in B$ for every $x\ne0$; $\mathfrak m_B=B\setminus B^\times$ and $\kappa(B)=B/\mathfrak m_B$. The field and transcendence conventions are [def-pc-field-extension, def-kun-transcendence-degree].
